rows.note: Use 流 as the all-purpose verb for liquid moving continuously, including blood when no outward direction is emphasized.

example.english: They scraped their knee, and blood continued to stream.
example.traditional: 佢跌親膝頭，血一路流緊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dit3 can1 sat1 tau4 hyut3 jat1 lou6 lau4 gan2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the force or movement of water.

example.english: The stream here is very strong, so be careful if you go into the water.
example.traditional: 呢段水流好急，落水要小心。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 seoi2 lau4 hou2 gap1 lok6 seoi2 jiu3 siu2 sam1

rows.note: Use this for an instance or channel of digital media being delivered over the internet.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 cyun3 lau4 tai2 tou3 hei3

rows.note: Use 直播 for broadcasting video or audio live over the internet.

example.english: We will stream the match live tonight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 wui5 zik6 bo3 coeng4 bo1

rows.note: Use it before the substance for a continuous physical flow or a surge of something, such as 一股奶 or 一股氣.

example.english: A stream of milk trickled out of the bottle and got all over the table.
example.traditional: 一股奶由奶樽流咗出嚟，成枱都係。
example.jyutping: jat1 gu2 naai5 jau4 naai5 zeon1 lau4 zo2 ceot1 lei4 seng4 toi4 dou1 hai6

rows.note: Use 流出 when blood or another liquid is specifically coming out of a wound, container, or other opening.

example.english: Blood continued to stream out of their wound.
example.traditional: 佢個傷口仲有血流出嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 soeng1 hau2 zung6 jau5 hyut3 lau4 ceot1 lei4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a small natural river or stream.

example.english: We saw a clear stream while hiking.
example.traditional: 我哋行山嗰陣見到一條清澈嘅溪流。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 gin3 dou2 jat1 tiu4 cing1 cit3 ge3 kai1 lau4

rows.note: Use 飄 for a flag, cloth, or similar object floating or fluttering in the wind.

example.english: The flag outside began to stream in the wind.
example.traditional: 門外嗰幅旗喺風中飄緊。
example.jyutping: mun4 ngoi6 go2 fuk1 kei4 hai2 fung1 zung1 piu1 gan2
